ways.time: 4 - 6 days round trip from Freshwater landing
evidence: The track starts directly opposite Freshwater Hut and travels down the swampy Freshwater valley to Tolson River – this area is prone to flooding.
The track climbs steeply up Adams Hill and across the swampy summit before descending through forest to Cavalier Creek on Mason Bay.
Follow the track to the Island Hill homestead and then over flat tussock and mānuka country to Freshwater River and Freshwater Hut.
The easiest way to start and finish the Southern Circuit is to arrange a water-taxi pick-up or drop-off at Freshwater Landing, Freds Camp or Rakeahua Hut.

doubts: The page describes the circuit in sections from Halfmoon Bay, but DOC's time '4 - 6 days round trip from Freshwater landing' and distance '71.5 km loop' match only the Freshwater Hut loop (the five sections Freshwater Hut to Freds Camp Hut, Rakeahua Hut, Doughboy Bay Hut, Mason Bay Hut and back to Freshwater Hut sum to 71.5 km). The main way is therefore that loop, starting and ending at Freshwater Hut, with Freshwater Landing, Freds Camp and Rakeahua Hut as water-taxi access points. The Halfmoon Bay/Oban circuit is W2, a separate loop described in its own sections; the page gives no total time or distance for it, only 'allow another 2–4 days', so its time is null. North Arm Hut is passed only on W2, so it is not listed under the main way's huts. Water-taxi pick-up or drop-off points are recorded as access points (the page does not say whether they lead onto anything beyond the circuit). Direction is not stated. Freshwater Landing has no feature or name entry, so its ref is null. Duck Creek has two river entries (T10, T11), so no Duck Creek ref is given.
